value.title: Passive system GPS cache evidence cannot change acquisition or disclose position
value.statement: Source schema4 raw_fix_elapsed_realtime_ms describes the existing rawGps measurement, including a possible cache seed, not exact callback entry time. Only an already emitted classified recovery report may perform at most one system GPS lastKnown read. The app extracts measurement time only and neither retains nor seeds the Location. Its ten fixed numeric/enum witness keys distinguish missing, invalid, future, denied, read and clock states; safe monotonic subtraction and relation enums preserve unknown/sentinel meaning. No coordinates, extras, accounts, URI, Location text or exception messages are added. No sensor activation, new observer, retry, classification, filter, recording or stored-data change. Binder execution time is not bounded by this observer; duration is reported. Cache/used-in-fix/registration evidence alone never establishes the root cause of a gap. Prior report replay remains historical and never acquires a new observation retrospectively.
